contracts: (Protected cleanup returns retained Project data and ordinary user operations do not return it.) AND (The targeted S2 selector verifies one logical quota release across initial soft delete and retry without requiring physical-byte reclamation.) AND (The targeted S2 selector verifies that the service entry records soft deletion and does not immediately remove the retained workspace.) AND (The targeted S2 selector verifies the persisted owner relation is unchanged and resolvable for protected cleanup after soft delete.)
selector_intents: Evaluate the persisted ownership boundary after soft delete and fail if the original owner cannot be resolved, ownership is deleted, or ownership changes to another requester.
Execute the S2 Project service-entry selector and observe a behavioral failure if deletion is physical, retained data disappears, or the soft-delete transition is bypassed.
Execute the S2 soft-delete selector with an initial transition and retry; observe a behavioral failure when quota is unchanged, decremented twice, or coupled to physical deletion.
Fail as a harness blocker if the required PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests selector is absent, undiscoverable, skipped, or cannot establish a nonzero test count.
